effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
